facts.fact: 兵器教官 Jack Xiao 集合点名，宣布只能用钝刃练习，谁弄伤手腕就要左手跑障碍跑到伤好为止
facts.quote: “Dull blades.” He selected a practice sword from the rack.

facts.fact: Delia 走出人群迎向 Max，早已选定用木剑而不是钝钢剑
facts.quote: She’d been waiting for this and had already chosen her weapon: a wooden blade. Not dull steel.

facts.fact: Max 怀疑有人已把她与金属亲和的事从哨站传回基地，因为 Drakken 有传讯链路并曾命她当面演示
facts.quote: Someone from the outpost had sent word back ahead of me.

facts.fact: Delia 压制 Max：剑面击中她的肋部，Max 架开两下、漏掉第三下，大腿中剑后腿软半步
facts.quote: She pressed. I parried two, missed the third, took the tip in my thigh.

facts.fact: Bryn 喊话 Xiao 抗议这场比赛不公平，Xiao 宣布只有一方喊出认输比赛才停
facts.quote: “Cadet Max or Cadet Delia says yield, the match stops.” Jack Xiao didn’t look up. “That’s the rule.”

facts.fact: Max 卸下前臂上的 Coldiron 护臂，护臂按她的意念重组成三节 sanjiegun 握在手中
facts.quote: The joints reformed, the brace lengthened, and a sanjiegun balanced in my grip.

facts.fact: Max 用 sanjiegun 击落 Delia 的木剑、勾住她的脚踝把她摔倒并用靴子按住，随后喊出认输，Xiao 判定 Delia 失败
facts.quote: She hit the ground back-first, the impact driving the air from her lungs in a sharp, ugly bark.

facts.fact: Frost 奉 Prince Aelindor 之命来找 Max；Delia 当面辱骂 Max 被 Xiao 斥责，Frost 随即抓臂掐喉把她提离地面警告不得再对他的王子无礼，随后将她甩开，Max 最后与 Frost 并肩走出
facts.quote: Frost’s other hand closing around her throat with two fingers and a thumb, Delia’s heels lifting off the floor by a foot.

relations: Jack Xiao 是 Vossmark 训练中心的兵器教官，负责剑术课
Max 的剑术基础来自 Greyhold 的 Frost 与 Marco
Delia 是 Max 的宿敌，在剑术课上点名挑战并当众压制她
Delia 自称王子女友，扬言要把事情告诉 Drakken
Frost 是 Prince Aelindor 的副官（major），以主子的名义压制冒犯者
Max 的 Coldiron 护臂可重组成三节 sanjiegun，其中有寄居的恶魔意识为她提示招式
Drakken 有到基地的传讯链路，并曾命令 Max 在众人面前展示金属亲和力
numbers: Twelve of them, every one of them with my name on it
